rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: CHAP CLIIII Whether Native overcome or be overcome by his Adversaries
rules.historical_meaning_only: This printed chapter starts on original PDF675 after CLIII on enemy quality.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Whether Native shall overcome or be overcome
rules.historical_meaning_only: Author's specific subject is alleged success or defeat against adversaries, distinct from enemy count and type.
A seventh-house ruler located in tenth is an alleged favorable overcoming indicator.
A tenth ruler located in seventh is the reciprocal alternative favorable configuration.
The author alleges successful overcoming for either seventh/tenth reciprocal ruler case.
Twelfth ruler located in tenth is a separate purported source route to victory.
Opposite exchange of tenth ruler into twelfth is another allowed alternate condition.
The text explicitly gives same claimed victory result for twelfth/tenth reciprocal conditions.
One compound condition requires twelfth ruler to be retrograde.
The ruler's zodiac fall is one permitted essential debility component.
Detriment is alternate to fall, not both required.
Placement in sixth is additionally required for the retrograde debilitated twelfth-ruler case.
The compound debilitated twelfth lord case allegedly indicates overcoming adversaries.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: The Luminaries especially that of time
rules.historical_meaning_only: One source method singles out the appropriate birth time luminary.
For births in daytime, the Sun is defined as source time ruler.
For night births, the Moon is selected instead of Sun.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: constituted in essential dignity of Mars
rules.historical_meaning_only: The selected luminary in Mars essential dignity is an alternative favorable sign.
House/domicile mutual reception gives an alternate source route.
Original source expressly excludes eighth-house placement from the favorable claim.
The author makes a categorical historical victory assertion rather than measured fight resolution.
A separate Mars-based case requires Mars to have greater strength than other planets.
Mars conjunct selected time luminary is one eligible source.
Proximity without exact conjunction is another source alternative, with no numeric orb supplied.
The source repeats alleged victory from strong Mars near or conjoined the selected luminary.
One malefic must occupy twelfth for the next compound claim.
Mars is also required in twelfth alongside Saturn in the compound.
The author restricts alleged enemy-mortality outcome to both being strong.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Native shall see death of Enemies
rules.historical_meaning_only: Unverified categorical fatal outcome, not an actionable natal or safety conclusion.
Debility in twelfth reverses the alleged outcome; preserves failure/negative case.
The source says weak malefics reverse stronger-case fatal outcome without defining precise event.
Separate physical disability is alleged in debilitated case, not equivalent to death.
A different case places ONE of the malefics in twelfth.
The other traditional malefic is located in sixth as another required condition.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: danger of being killed by Enemies
rules.historical_meaning_only: The author alleges an extremely high-stakes risk not supported by observed real people.
Permanent illness is offered as an alternative under same planetary case.
Imprisonment is a third distinct alternative outcome for the same source case.
Jupiter as twelfth ruler is an alternate candidate in supposed protection case.
Venus is another alternative beneficiary if ruling twelfth.
The author asserts absence of injury under benefic twelfth rulers.
Escape or avoidance of supposed enemy harms is separate from no enemies existing.
Gemini rising is one historical purported conflict-prone case.
Sagittarius rising is another alternative.
Aquarius rising is the third sign listed.
The author attributes antagonism to native behavior, which is not evidence of real character.
Leo twelfth is one source sign in an alleged horse-fall scenario.
Sagittarius is alternate sign in twelfth, not an extra necessary sign.
A further malefic occupying twelfth is required in alleged accident case.
Horse-related accident is a separate old transportation event claim.
The same case alleges subsequent death, unsupported by any observed fatality records.
An internal unnumbered source heading within CLIIII shifts to alleged dangerous friendship.
One old avoid-friend criterion uses the OTHER person's Ascendant ruler as a malefic.
South lunar node adds a historic qualifier; original glyph parity is not independently verified.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: or fixed star of ill influence
rules.historical_meaning_only: An alleged unfavorable fixed-star contact is another alternative qualifier.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: or Nativity agrees not with own
rules.historical_meaning_only: Claimed two-chart discord is an alternate method, not equivalent to malefic Ascendant ruler.
The historical injunction is not an actual interpersonal recommendation or threat prediction.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: will offend thee though no mind unto it
rules.historical_meaning_only: The author even permits harm without intent, a different outcome from malicious wrongdoing.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Luminary of ones Geniture afflict another
rules.historical_meaning_only: A luminary in one person's chart adversely contacting other's chart is a separate source input.
Cross-chart square is one adverse aspect condition.
Cross-chart opposition is alternate to square.
A categorical lifelong rivalry claim has no actual paired human evidence.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: more in numbers and evident Significators
rules.historical_meaning_only: The author claims the party with more favorable victory/fortune testimonies prevails.
The source calls relative triumph based on unweighted count, no calibrated win model.
